svg.aria-label: A workbench with two stations joined by a rail. On the left, a hydraulic press stamps all eight prompt tokens into a tray of key and value tiles in one stroke: prefill. The carriage then carries the tray along the rail to the right-hand station: the KV cache handoff. There, a gantry sweeps a read bar over every cached tile before each new token is added, one tile pair at a time: decode.
